title: The capture length of pcap and the original packet length can be different
summary: The caplen field gives the number of captured bytes that follow. The original length can include bytes omitted due to capture limits.
applies: Legacy libpcap format; single interface capture
detail: When incl_len is 64 and orig_len is 1514, only 64 bytes must be spanned from this data area to the next record.
boundary: There is no way to tell about data corruption on the line just from the missing trailer, nor can you recover the uncaught bytes from the length field.
relevance: Troubleshoot the problem of missing end of the payload and misreading of the next header.
